stories.headline: Basketball Intelligence Releases Latest NBA Insights and Rookie Rankings
stories.summary: The latest edition of Basketball Intelligence covers a wide range of NBA topics, featuring updated Rookie of the Year rankings and analysis on surging scoring trends among first-year players. The newsletter also highlights team-specific updates, including roster questions for the Chicago Bulls and coaching adjustments by the Boston Celtics.

stories.headline: Exploring the Identity of the Biblical God
stories.summary: The Gospel Coalition provides theological commentary and featured essays examining the nature of God as depicted in scripture. Contributors explore core attributes like holiness, sovereignty, and grace. The resource page directs readers to deeper studies on Christian doctrine.

stories.headline: The Theological Impact of the Lord's Supper
stories.summary: The Gospel Coalition publishes an essay examining how communion fosters spiritual maturity in believers. The piece explores the historical and practical significance of the ordinance within Christian worship. It encourages congregations to view the ritual as vital fuel for daily faith.

stories.headline: Meta's VR Glasses Offer a Glimpse at What Apple's Vision Pro 2 Should Be
stories.summary: Tech creator MKBHD explores Meta's latest VR hardware developments, examining features and design elements that rival Apple's ecosystem. The video breaks down how these Meta prototypes point toward future standards for spatial computing and mixed reality headsets.

stories.headline: The OLED iPad Mini Embodies Peak Apple Design Philosophy
stories.summary: A deep dive into rumors and concepts surrounding an OLED iPad Mini reveals a device that encapsulates classic Apple engineering trends. The review-style commentary analyzes the appeal of high-end small-form-factor tablets within Apple's lineup.

stories.headline: Full Stack Creator Discusses New MacBook Pros
stories.summary: The Full Stack Creator podcast features a detailed conversation about Apple's latest MacBook Pro models equipped with PROLED XDR displays. The discussion dives deep into the hardware upgrades and what these new screens mean for professional workflows.

stories.headline: MacBook Pro XDR Impressions: Defying Industry Expectations
stories.summary: First impressions of the MacBook Pro with an XDR display highlight features critics claimed Apple would never implement. The video covers user feedback, display performance, and how this machine shifts expectations for professional laptops.

stories.headline: Marques Brownlee Blind Ranks Halloween Candy in the Studio
stories.summary: The MKBHD crew takes a break from tech to rank popular Halloween candies blindly. The casual studio video features lighthearted debates over the best and worst sweet treats of the season.

stories.headline: Testing Your Knowledge on Obscure Foldable Phones
stories.summary: The MKBHD studio team challenges themselves to identify lesser-known foldable smartphones from various global manufacturers. The segment highlights the diverse and experimental hardware emerging in the foldable device market outside of mainstream brands.

stories.headline: OpenAI Raises $11B at $1.25T Valuation
stories.summary: OpenAI secured $11 billion in fresh funding from backers including SoftBank and MGX at a $1.25 trillion valuation. While a massive milestone, the total fell short of the company's initial $1.4 trillion target following an AI stock market sell-off. The round's pricing dynamics and slower close are rippling through major tech stakeholders like Microsoft and Nvidia.

stories.headline: Bet you didn't know what we shot the intro on
Developer Ditches Claude Code for Pi After Persistent Frustrations
stories.summary: A software developer writes a retrospective on why they abandoned Claude Code as their primary AI coding harness in favor of Pi. Key pain points included rigid configuration files, broken multi-tab IDE support, and inadequate GUI tool features that made long-term use unviable.

stories.headline: Inside Donald Fagen's Post-Steely Dan Solo Debut
stories.summary: Pitchfork reviews Donald Fagen's 1982 solo album, The Nightfly, examining its thematic ties to Steely Dan's turbulent history. The record arrived after the grueling sessions for Gaucho and the temporary dissolution of his long-running partnership with Walter Becker.

stories.headline: The Gospel Coalition Publishes Guidance on Contending Without Contentiousness
stories.summary: The Gospel Coalition highlights theological essays and commentary focused on maintaining faith and conviction without resorting to hostility. The resource page directs readers to articles addressing Christian conduct, doctrine, and respectful discourse.

stories.headline: Internalizing Christ's Sermon Reshapes Daily Spiritual Habits
stories.summary: A reflection for The Gospel Coalition examines how memorizing the Sermon on the Mount directly affects an individual's spiritual alignment and heart posture. Committing Jesus's teachings in Matthew 5–7 to memory provides believers with an enduring mental framework to navigate conflict and temptation.

stories.headline: New Zealand Election Ends Without Clear Winner
stories.summary: New Zealand's recent election concluded with no decisive majority for either the left or right blocks, signaling voter frustration with traditional majorities. Prime Minister Christopher Luxon will lead a caretaker government while intense negotiations with minor parties begin. These smaller factions now hold significant leverage to demand major policy concessions.

stories.headline: Run Massive AI Models Locally on CPU RAM
stories.summary: The llama-modchip project allows users to run large models like DeepSeek-V4-Flash and various MoEs entirely on standard CPU RAM without needing a dedicated GPU. By utilizing hardware optimizations and clever memory management, it achieves impressive token generation speeds on consumer hardware.

stories.headline: Undocumented Daemons Build Personal Knowledge Graphs on Macs
stories.summary: Every Mac running recent versions of macOS quietly operates background daemons that construct a comprehensive personal knowledge graph. This system cross-references data from Contacts, Calendar, Messages, and location logs to map your relationships and habits for on-device AI retrieval.

stories.headline: Self-Learning AI Issues Week 9 NFL Predictions
stories.summary: An automated betting model has released its data-driven score predictions and best bets for every matchup in Week 9 of the NFL season. The self-learning system evaluates incoming sports data to generate its weekly prognostications.

stories.headline: Los Angeles Orbit Unveils 2026-27 LOVB Schedule Highlighted by Intuit Dome Opener
stories.summary: Expansion franchise Los Angeles Orbit will kick off their inaugural League One Volleyball season away against Houston on December 18 before hosting Nebraska for their first home match at the Intuit Dome on January 6. The 22-match schedule features 11 home games in Inglewood as part of the league's newly introduced conference play structure.

stories.headline: The Gospel Coalition Examines Inspiration Behind 'I Play Rocky'
stories.summary: The Gospel Coalition website features ongoing commentary, essays, and theological discussions exploring faith, history, and cultural topics. The platform serves as a hub for contemporary religious writing and media resources.

stories.headline: Paraguayan President Impeached and Arrested Following Ueno Bank Collapse
stories.summary: President Santiago Peña was unanimously impeached and placed under house arrest after the collapse of Ueno Bank froze access to accounts for over half of Paraguay's population. Prosecutors allege Peña manipulated regulatory oversight and had conflicts of interest tied to the failed digital bank, while his deputy Pedro Alliana has been sworn in as interim president.

stories.headline: Russian Missile and Drone Strikes Batter Ukrainian Energy Grid Ahead of Trilateral Talks
stories.summary: Overnight Russian ballistic missile and drone attacks struck 12 Ukrainian regions, damaging critical energy infrastructure and leaving parts of Kyiv facing blackouts and heating disruptions. The assault comes directly ahead of upcoming trilateral negotiations scheduled to take place in Abu Dhabi.

stories.headline: US Offers $20 Million Reward for Intelligence on Iran's Nuclear Program
stories.summary: The U.S. State Department is offering up to $20 million through its Rewards for Justice program for actionable details regarding Iran's nuclear facilities, equipment, and personnel. Simultaneously, the U.S. military is establishing Task Force Iron Gate in Florida to crack down on illegal Iranian weapon smuggling and sanctioned border shipments.

stories.headline: Exploring the History of Economic Populism in Texas
stories.summary: Political commentator David Griscom discusses his book 'The Myth of Red Texas' with NPR, shedding light on the state's often-forgotten history of economic populism. The conversation explores political movements in Texas that challenge the traditional single-party narrative.

stories.headline: NBA Intelligence: Celtics Dominate, Bulls Struggle
stories.summary: Recent NBA analysis highlights Boston's long-range shooting dominance and Sam Hauser's elite ball security. Meanwhile, the Chicago Bulls are playing at a league-high pace that is currently failing to yield offensive results.

stories.headline: Police Use In-App Ads to Track Phone Users
stories.summary: Law enforcement agencies are increasingly leveraging targeted advertising data harvested from popular mobile applications to track citizens' physical locations. This hidden surveillance pipeline allows authorities to bypass traditional warrant processes for digital movement history.

stories.headline: Pope Leo XIV Travels to Argentina After Uruguay Visit
stories.summary: Pope Leo concluded his trip to Uruguay by celebrating local religious traditions and praising women for preserving the faith. He is now heading to Argentina for the most politically sensitive leg of his South American tour, where he faces friction over the austerity measures enacted by President Javier Milei.

stories.headline: Gen Z Voters Fuel Democratic Midterm Wave
stories.summary: Voters under 30 decisively backed Democratic candidates in the recent midterms, delivering a stark rebuke to President Trump's party. This nearly 50-point margin represents a sharp rebound for Democrats after losing crucial ground with young voters during the 2024 election cycle.

stories.headline: Discord's Rust Rebuild Shatters Electron Performance on Windows 11
stories.summary: Discord is testing a new native Rust-based client on Windows 11 that completely skips the traditional startup loading screen. Demonstrations show the app booting instantly and consuming 70% less RAM—running at 290.2MB with two accounts signed in simultaneously.

stories.headline: Delap Brace Lifts Forest Past Manchester City
stories.summary: Liam Delap scored a brilliant double to lead Nottingham Forest to a stunning 3-1 victory over Manchester City. The win marks Forest's first Premier League home victory at the City Ground this season.

stories.headline: Odegaard Penalty Extends Arsenal's League Lead
stories.summary: Captain Martin Odegaard secured a narrow 1-0 victory for Arsenal against Hull City. The crucial three points allow the Gunners to further pad their lead at the top of the Premier League table.

stories.headline: Datasette Drops rel=next HTTP Headers for Firefox to Prevent Wasteful Preloads
stories.summary: Simon Willison discovered that Datasette was triggering unnecessary prefetch requests in Firefox due to 'link: rel=next' HTTP headers on HTML pages. Because only a fraction of visitors click to the next page, he disabled the headers to stop browsers from fetching redundant data.

stories.headline: JIT Bitmap Text Rendering Speeds Up RP2350 Microcontrollers
stories.summary: Developer Raph Levien is building a retro computer recreation on the RP2350 microcontroller using JIT compilation for bitmap text. By generating highly optimized code on the fly to render strings, the technique achieves fast performance while keeping the crisp aesthetic of proportional bitmap fonts.

stories.headline: Claude Code Security Flaw Leaks Passwords on GitHub
stories.summary: An oversight involving Claude Code's bypass prompts has resulted in sensitive passwords leaking across more than a thousand public GitHub repositories. The exposure highlights growing security risks associated with automated developer tooling and agentic coding workflows.

stories.headline: Building a Ten-Dollar Homelab
stories.summary: A tech enthusiast details their experience setting up a fully functional, silent home server using an ultra-cheap $10 OpenStick running Debian and Podman. Despite having modest hardware like 512 MB of RAM and quad ARM Cortex-A53 cores, the pocket-sized device successfully runs lightweight self-hosted tools including an ad blocker and YouTube sponsor skipper.

stories.headline: The Gospel Coalition Spotlights New Children's Books
stories.summary: The Gospel Coalition's latest editor's pick highlights a fresh selection of children's picture books. The curated titles center around Christian themes and foundational faith concepts for young readers.

stories.headline: Leeds Ends Winless Skid With Upset Over Spurs
stories.summary: Noah Okafor scored the game's lone goal as Leeds United edged Tottenham Hotspur 1-0 in Premier League action. The hard-fought victory snaps a five-game winless drought that dates back to mid-September.

stories.headline: Houthis Report Dozens Dead in Saudi Airstrike
stories.summary: Houthi-run media in Yemen claim that at least 25 people, including women and children, were killed in a Saudi-led coalition airstrike targeting the town of al-Shariyah. The renewed violence follows the collapse of a regional truce, leaving hundreds of thousands displaced and escalating hostilities across the country.

stories.headline: Gloomy New Zealand Voters Deliver Closest Election in Years
stories.summary: New Zealand voters have delivered an unusually tight and fragmented election amid widespread economic anxiety and political fatigue. The historic shift fractured support away from major parties, empowering minor factions like the centrist Opportunity Party to potentially hold the balance of power.

stories.headline: Barnier Warns UK Against Cherry-Picking EU Single Market Access
stories.summary: Former EU Brexit negotiator Michel Barnier has stated that the UK cannot selectively choose elements of the single market to rejoin without accepting all conditions. Responding to Prime Minister Andy Burnham's push for closer economic ties, Barnier emphasized that access requires committing to the "four freedoms," including the free movement of people. European officials maintain that while the door to rejoining remains open, the terms must apply equally to all participants.

stories.headline: Houston Mayor Orders Police to Limit ICE Cooperation
stories.summary: Houston Mayor John Whitmire signed an executive order directing city police to scale back cooperation with federal immigration enforcement, ensuring officers will only contact ICE if detained individuals carry internal administrative warrants for jailable offenses. The policy shift follows local outrage over an ICE shooting and comes in the wake of significant Democratic victories in Texas.

stories.headline: NFL Week 9: Jets vs. Chiefs Betting Preview
stories.summary: CBS Sports provides comprehensive betting odds, point spreads, and expert predictions for the Week 9 matchup between the Jets and Chiefs. Bettors can review the latest lines and start times to inform their game-day strategies.

stories.headline: NFL Week 9: Giants vs. Eagles Betting Preview
stories.summary: An analytical look at the odds, point spread, and expert predictions for the Week 9 divisional clash between the New York Giants and Philadelphia Eagles. The preview outlines key betting lines and kickoff details for the matchup.

stories.headline: Prominent Astrophysicist Departs the United States
stories.summary: A leading astrophysicist has left the United States, drawing public attention amid ongoing political shifts. The departure highlights broader concerns within the scientific community regarding domestic policies.

stories.headline: Ornadyne's Bird-Shaped O1 Drone Evades Detection in Air Force Test
stories.summary: Ornadyne's 1-pound O1 ornithopter successfully bypassed counter-UAS sensor detection during the Air Force's "Game of Drones" exercise at Edwards Air Force Base. By flapping its wings instead of using propellers, the crow-like drone operates much more quietly while mimicking native wildlife.

stories.headline: Iran Executes Three Men Over January Anti-Government Protests
stories.summary: Iranian authorities have executed Hassan Dioband, Hamid Kazemi, and Reza Zanganeh for allegedly participating in armed unrest and attacking public facilities during January protests. State media claimed the men acted on behalf of the U.S. and Israel, amid international condemnation over surging executions.

stories.headline: Sunday Night Football: Buccaneers vs. Bears Week 9 Predictions
stories.summary: A proven statistical model shares its top picks, odds, and game analysis for the Sunday Night Football showdown between the Tampa Bay Buccaneers and Chicago Bears. Fans can check out the predicted outcomes and betting lines ahead of kickoff.

stories.headline: Odell Beckham Jr. Projected to Debut for Vikings Following Roster Promotion
stories.summary: Wide receiver Odell Beckham Jr. is reportedly set to make his first appearance for the Minnesota Vikings after being signed directly to the active 53-man roster. The addition injects a veteran presence into the Vikings' offense ahead of their upcoming schedule.

stories.headline: What Happens After Employees Hit the Peter Principle
stories.summary: Researchers argue that employees who stall at their level of incompetence do not simply plateau, but face intense career pressure that can make them dangerous. To survive or advance, these stuck workers often resort to high-risk tasks, organizational dirty work, or sabotaging superiors.
